checks.claim: The content model is defined and editors can edit content without code.
checks.evidence_required: The post types/fields/taxonomies or headless schema, plus an editor changing copy without a code change.
checks.how_to_run: Read the content model; perform or observe one editor edit on staging.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

source.quote: editors can edit content without code

checks.claim: No secrets in the theme or repo; wp-config values and API tokens are in env and wp-config.php is not committed.
checks.evidence_required: git ls-files shows no wp-config.php with real values; a search for tokens in the theme returns nothing.
checks.how_to_run: git ls-files plus a search for secret patterns in theme/plugin code.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

checks.claim: WordPress: output escaped, input sanitized, $wpdb->prepare used, nonces and capability checks on state-changing actions, child theme, vetted pinned plugins.
checks.evidence_required: A code read of every state-changing handler and query showing escaping, sanitizing, prepare, nonce and capability checks.
checks.how_to_run: Search theme/plugin PHP for echo, $wpdb queries and admin-post/ajax handlers; check each.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

checks.claim: Headless: server-side tokens are not exposed to the client, CMS-to-build webhooks are signature-verified and CORS is locked to known origins.
checks.evidence_required: A search of the client bundle for tokens with no hits, a webhook verification test, and the CORS config.
checks.how_to_run: Build the front-end, search the bundle; run the webhook test; read the CORS config.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

source.quote: server-side tokens not exposed to the client

checks.claim: A backup is taken before any migration or update; migrations are reversible and tested on staging; serialized data changed with a serialization-safe tool.
checks.evidence_required: The backup artifact reference and a staging run of the migration plus its reversal.
checks.how_to_run: Owner-side: run the backup and the staged migration (WP-CLI) and quote the output.
checks.honesty_note: Without PHP + MySQL + WP-CLI (owner-side), backup, migration and live verification are NOT_RUN.

source.quote: Backup taken before any migration/update; migrations reversible + tested on staging

checks.claim: Performance (caching, image optimization, CWV budget) and accessibility are verified on the rendered output.
checks.evidence_required: A Lighthouse or CWV measurement and an accessibility check of the rendered site.
checks.how_to_run: Run Lighthouse (or PageSpeed) on the rendered site and an a11y checker; quote the numbers.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

source.quote: a11y (semantic, alt text, heading order, contrast) verified on rendered output.

checks.claim: Core, themes and plugins are on patched versions; user roles are least-privilege.
checks.evidence_required: The version list of core/themes/plugins and the role assignments.
checks.how_to_run: Owner-side: wp core version / wp plugin list; read the role setup.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

source.quote: Core/themes/plugins on patched versions; user roles least-privilege.

hard_gates.gate: Back up DB + uploads before any plugin/theme/core update or content migration; migrate on staging first.
